startPanel.title: JUMP
startPanel.instructions: Collect stars to perform tricks! Press Space to activate the special tricks, save stars to unlock moves

key.title: KEY
key.key1: Land in the pants to bounce!
key.key2: Land on the bird to fly!
key.key5: Collect the stars to do tricks!

instructions.title: HOW TO PLAY
instructions.body_1: Use your arrow keys or mouse to move Shaun left or right
instructions.body_2: Collect stars for trick power - press space or click to do tricks
instructions.body_3: Pants and birds will help you, but avoid spiky red branches!
instructions.body_4: Make sure Shaun lands in the bucket!
